numeric_correctness.note: All face-statement values (59 FY2025 + 82 FY2024 comparative facts) and all 72 five-year table facts match the source. Defects are definition/composition problems (capex, asset-sale proceeds, D&A), one double-counted debt component (599k), one summation error (100k), a conflicting-basis pair of sales volumes and two mislabelled metrics. document_completeness.note: The annual report carries full audited FY2025 and FY2024 (restated) statements plus FY2021-2023 only as summary tables. Many face-statement lines are not extracted (derivatives, equity/debt investments, general reserve 2024, JV/associate results, impairment of associates, most cash-flow lines), so FY2024 equity components do not add to equity.

company_coverage.note: Published: FY2025 full, FY2024 full (restated comparative), FY2021-FY2023 summary metrics only. NO quarterly, H1 or 9M period for any year and no full statements for FY2021-FY2023 are published; SABIC reports quarterly so this is a material gap.
